integrity: Proof supplies all-n algebra and independent exact-fraction checks; the latter corroborate finite instances only. Scientific literature comparison does not certify absolute novelty.
scientific_limitations: Standard binary Kingman coalescent with each lineage pair merging at rate one; n >= 4. No extension to multiple mergers or varying population size. Possible earlier equivalent results in incompletely accessible historical literature.
title: A sample-size-invariant cherry–external-length covariance in Kingman’s coalescent
